data.one_liner: A widget that cross-fades from a placeholder to a loaded image with progress and error support.
data.what_it_does: ImageFade is a Flutter widget that displays a placeholder and optional progress indicator while an image loads. Once loaded, it cross-fades to the target image and handles error states. It also supports sync durations and dynamic image updates.
use_when: You want to display a placeholder with a cross-fade animation when loading images.
You need loading progress or error handling built directly into your image widget.
You are using CachedNetworkImageProvider and want smooth fade transitions.
avoid_when: You only need basic built-in Flutter image fade-in capabilities without custom placeholders or progress indicators.
strengths: Supports custom placeholders, loading builders, and error builders.
Uses optimized performance paths like Image.opacity and AnimatedBuilder.
weaknesses: Limited to image rendering and transition features only.
Does not include advanced disk/memory caching out of the box (requires an external provider like CachedNetworkImageProvider).

alternatives.name: cached_network_image
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides a comprehensive image loading and caching solution with built-in placeholder and error widgets.

alternatives.name: octo_image
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides flexible image building with placeholders, error widgets, and various image transformers.

data.minimal_example:
ImageFade(
  image: NetworkImage(url),
  duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 900),
  placeholder: Container(
    color: const Color(0xFFCFCDCA),
  ),
)
